# Casdoor

> Casdoor is an open-source, UI-first Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Single Sign-On (SSO) platform written in Go. It supports OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, CAS, LDAP, SCIM, WebAuthn, TOTP, MFA, RADIUS and Kerberos, includes an MCP server, and acts as an OAuth 2.1 authorization server for MCP servers and AI agents.

## The basics

- [Overview](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/overview/): Casdoor Overview
- [核心概念](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/basic/core-concepts/): 组织、用户、应用和提供商——Casdoor 的主要构成模块。
- [Server installation](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/basic/server-installation/): Install and configure the Casdoor server from source or pre-built binaries.
- [配置](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/basic/configuration/): 通过app.conf和Conf.js配置Casdoor后端和前端。
- [使用Docker尝试](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/basic/try-with-docker/): 使用Docker或Docker Compose运行Casdoor，以进行快速测试或生产。
- [使用Helm尝试](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/basic/try-with-helm/): 使用Helm在Kubernetes上部署Casdoor，实现可管理、可扩展的部署。
- [公共API](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/basic/public-api/): 从您的应用和脚本中对Casdoor REST API进行身份验证并调用。
- [教程](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/basic/tutorials/): 使用Casdoor进行单点登录或身份验证的第三方产品文档和文章。

## Comparisons

- [Casdoor vs. alternatives](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/comparison/overview/): How Casdoor compares with Keycloak, Authentik, Auth0, and Logto on language, license, protocols, AI agent and MCP support, and operations.
- [Casdoor vs. Keycloak](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-keycloak/): A practical comparison of Casdoor and Keycloak - architecture, protocols, customization, AI agent and MCP support, operations, and how to migrate users from Keycloak.
- [Casdoor vs. Authentik](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-authentik/): Casdoor and Authentik compared for self-hosted SSO - architecture, flows and UI customization, protocols, reverse-proxy authentication, licensing, and AI agent support.
- [Casdoor vs. Auth0](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-auth0/): Casdoor compared with Auth0 - open source and self-hosting versus a managed service, pricing model, data residency, customization, and AI agent and MCP support.
- [Casdoor vs. Logto](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/comparison/casdoor-vs-logto/): Casdoor and Logto compared - language and license, databases, protocols, multi-tenancy, enterprise directory features, and authentication for AI agents and MCP servers.

## LLM

- [OpenClaw](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/llm/openclaw/): Collect LLM agent traces, metrics, and logs in Casdoor using the OpenClaw observability agent.
- [MCP security](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/llm/mcp-security/): How Casdoor secures MCP deployments — OAuth 2.1 for access control and OpenTelemetry for audit and observability.

## Deployment

- [使用Docker部署](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/docker/): 使用Docker或Docker Compose以及可选的反向代理运行Casdoor。
- [在Nginx后端部署](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/nginx/): 将Nginx置于Casdoor后端之前，以提供并代理流量。
- [部署到 Kubernetes](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/k8s/): 使用示例清单在 Kubernetes 集群中部署 Casdoor。
- [数据初始化](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/data-initialization/): 使用JSON配置文件初始化或迁移Casdoor数据。
- [在CDN中托管静态文件](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/deploy-cdn/): 使用存储提供商将Casdoor前端静态资源部署到CDN。
- [在内网托管静态文件](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/deploy-intranet/): 从内网可访问的URL提供Casdoor静态资产。
- [数据库迁移](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/db-migration/): Casdoor如何处理数据库模式和数据迁移。
- [版本信息](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/deployment/version-info/): Casdoor 如何报告二进制文件、Docker 和 git 构建的版本。

## Connecting to Casdoor

- [概览](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/overview/): 使用OAuth 2.0、OIDC、SAML或CAS将您的应用程序连接到Casdoor。
- [标准OIDC客户端](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/oidc-client/): 使用发现端点，通过任何OIDC客户端连接到Casdoor。
- [Casdoor SDKs](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/sdk/): Use Casdoor SDKs for frontend and backend integration with user management and more.
- [Single sign-on (SSO)](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/session/single-sign-on/): Let users sign in once and access all apps in the organization without signing in again.
- [Single sign-out (SSO logout)](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/session/single-sign-out/): Log users out from all applications in the organization at once.
- [RP-initiated logout](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/session/rp-initiated-logout/): Log a user out of Casdoor from a relying party using the OIDC RP-Initiated Logout endpoint.
- [Vue SDK](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/vue-sdk/): Use Casdoor in Vue 2 or Vue 3 with the official Vue SDK.
- [Electron app](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/electron-app/): 在 Electron 应用中通过 OAuth 和自定义协议集成 Casdoor。
- [.NET桌面应用](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/dotnet-app/): 在使用WebView2的.NET桌面应用中集成Casdoor。
- [.NET MAUI app](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/maui-app/): 使用OpenID Connect将Casdoor集成到.NET MAUI应用（Android、Windows等）中。
- [Qt desktop app](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/desktop-sdks/qt-app/): 在使用WebEngine的Qt（C++）桌面应用中集成Casdoor。
- [React Native app](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mobile-sdks/react-native-app/): Integrate Casdoor in a React Native app with the official SDK.
- [Casdoor CLI](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/cli/): 使用 Casdoor 的官方命令行界面管理用户、组和权限
- [插件和中间件](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/plugin/): 适用于Spring Boot、WordPress、Odoo、Django和Chrome的Casdoor官方插件。
- [Chrome扩展](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/chrome-extension/): 在Chrome扩展程序中集成Casdoor OAuth。
- [Next.js](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/nextjs/): 在 Next.js 应用中通过中间件和 JS SDK 集成 Casdoor。
- [Nuxt](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/nuxt/): Integrate Casdoor in a Nuxt app with middleware and the JS SDK.
- [OAuth 2.0](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/oauth/): 通过Casdoor的OAuth 2.0端点获取、验证和使用访问令牌。
- [客人身份验证](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/guest-auth/): 创建无需凭据的临时用户，稍后可对其进行升级。
- [Kerberos/SPNEGO身份验证](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/kerberos/): 为单点登录配置 Kerberos/SPNEGO（集成 Windows 身份验证）。
- [Casdoor作为CAS服务器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/cas/): 将Casdoor用作中央身份验证服务（CAS）服务器，适用于CAS 1.0、2.0和3.0。
- [SAML IdP overview](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/saml/overview/): Use Casdoor as a SAML 2.0 identity provider.
- [AWS 客户端 VPN (SAML)](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/saml/aws/): 将Casdoor用作AWS Client VPN的SAML IdP。
- [Keycloak（SAML）](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/saml/keycloak/): 在Keycloak中使用Casdoor作为SAML身份提供商。
- [Google Workspace (SAML)](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/saml/google-workspace/): 将Casdoor用作Google Workspace单点登录的SAML身份提供商。
- [Appgate（SAML POST）](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/saml/appgate/): 将Casdoor用作Appgate SDP的SAML身份提供商（通过POST发送SAMLResponse）。
- [腾讯云（SAML）](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/saml/tencent-cloud/): 将Casdoor用作腾讯云CAM的SAML身份提供商。
- [MCP服务器概览](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/overview/): 通过JSON-RPC 2.0以编程方式访问Casdoor的MCP服务器。
- [MCP authentication](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/authentication/): MCP服务器的OAuth发现与身份验证方法。
- [MCP工具参考](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/tools/): 列出并调用MCP工具（应用程序及其他）。
- [MCP授权和范围](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/authorization/): 基于范围的 MCP 工具访问控制。
- [MCP integration example](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/integration/): Python example: scoped token and MCP tool calls.
- [MCP错误处理](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/error-handling/): JSON-RPC错误码及来自MCP服务器的响应。
- [MCP 故障排除](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/troubleshooting/): 常见的MCP和OAuth问题及其调试方法。
- [将Claude Desktop连接到MCP](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/connect-claude-desktop/): 通过OAuth将Claude Desktop连接到Casdoor的MCP服务器
- [将光标连接到MCP](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/connect-cursor/): 将Cursor IDE通过OAuth连接到Casdoor的MCP服务器。
- [将ChatGPT连接到MCP](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/mcp/connect-chatgpt/): 通过OAuth将ChatGPT连接到Casdoor的MCP服务器。
- [面部识别](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/face-id/): 使用face-api.js通过面容ID登录。
- [WebAuthn](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/how-to-connect/webauthn/): 使用WebAuthn登录（密码密钥、指纹、面部识别、安全密钥）。

## 组织

- [概述](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/organization/overview/): Organizations are the core unit in Casdoor for managing users and applications.
- [Organization tree](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/organization/organization-tree/): User groups and group hierarchy within an organization.
- [Password complexity](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/organization/passwordComplexity/): Configure password strength rules per organization.
- [Password obfuscator](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/organization/passwordObfuscator/): Encrypt password parameters in login and set-password APIs.
- [Account customization](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/organization/accountCustomization/): Control visibility and edit permissions for each user account field.
- [Customize theme](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/organization/customize-theme/): Set primary color and border radius at global, organization, or application level.
- [MFA items](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/organization/mfa-items/): Configure which MFA methods are available and whether they are optional or required.

## 应用

- [概览](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/overview/): 了解 Casdoor 中的应用程序工作原理，以及如何为您的服务配置身份验证。
- [应用程序术语](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/terminology/): 应用程序配置字段和选项的参考，按选项卡组织。
- [应用程序配置](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/config/): 为您的Casdoor应用程序配置身份验证和回调URL。
- [动态客户端注册](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/dynamic-client-registration/): 通过RFC 7591（DCR）以编程方式注册OAuth客户端。
- [应用程序类别](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/categories/): 默认（面向用户）与Agent（M2M）应用及其类型。
- [自定义范围](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/scopes/): 为Agent应用程序定义自定义OAuth作用域（例如MCP服务器）。
- [Providers](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/providers/): Attach providers to your application and set rules (signup, login, forgot password, MFA, etc.).
- [登录方式](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/signin-methods/): 配置登录页面上可用的登录方式及其顺序。
- [专属登录](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/exclusive-signin/): 每个用户每应用仅允许一个活动会话。
- [注册项目表](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/signup-items-table/): 配置注册项以构建自定义注册页面。
- [登录项目表格](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/signin-items-table/): 配置登录项以构建自定义登录页面。
- [登录界面自定义](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/ui-customization/): 自定义登录页面：背景、面板样式、位置和侧边栏。
- [指定登录组织](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/specify-login-organization/): 让用户在登录页面上选择或输入组织。
- [应用标签](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/tags/): 将登录限制为标签与应用程序标签匹配的用户。
- [邀请码](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/invitation-code/): 将应用程序注册限制为拥有有效邀请码的用户。
- [共享应用](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/application/shared-application/): 使用一个应用程序跨多个组织，每个组织使用特定的客户端ID。

## MCP authorization

- [Casdoor as MCP Auth Provider](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/mcp-auth/overview/): Use Casdoor as an external OAuth 2.1 authorization server for third-party MCP servers
- [MCP auth setup](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/mcp-auth/setup/): Configure Casdoor as the OAuth server for your MCP server.
- [Third-party MCP server integration](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/mcp-auth/third-party-integration/): Runnable code examples for MCP servers using Casdoor OAuth (Python, Node.js, Go).
- [Public MCP Server Registry](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/mcp-auth/mcp-registry/): A curated registry of publicly available MCP servers, with a web UI and machine-readable JSON API.

## 权限

- [概述](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/permission/overview/): Use Casbin to manage fine-grained access control for users and resources in your organization.
- [Permission configuration](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/permission/permission-configuration/): Configure Casbin permission policies and each field on the Edit Permission page.
- [开放的 Casbin API](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/permission/exposed-casbin-apis/): Call Casbin from your backend to enforce and manage permissions.
- [适配器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/permission/adapter/): Connect Casbin policy storage (database) and manage policies in the UI.

- [Keycloak SAML](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/saml/keycloak/): Use Keycloak as a SAML IdP for Casdoor sign-in.
- [Alibaba Cloud IDaaS SAML](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/saml/aliyun/): Use Alibaba Cloud IDaaS (EIAM) as a SAML IdP for Casdoor.
- [支付提供商概览](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/overview/): 添加支付提供商，以便用户可以为产品付款。
- [模拟付款](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/dummy/): 用于测试和开发的模拟支付提供商。
- [余额支付](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/Balance/): 允许用户使用其Casdoor账户余额（钱包）进行支付。

- [FastSpring](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/payment/FastSpring/): 将FastSpring用作数字产品和订阅的支付提供商。

- [Cloudflare Turnstile](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/captcha/cloudflareTurnstile/): Add Cloudflare Turnstile captcha to your application.

- [Geetest captcha](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/captcha/geetest/): Add Geetest CAPTCHA V4 to your application.
- [MetaMask Web3](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/web3/metamask/): 将MetaMask用作Web3登录提供商。
- [Web3-Onboard](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/web3/web3onboard/): Use Web3-Onboard to support multiple wallets for Web3 sign-in.

- [Alibaba Cloud FaceBody](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/faceid/alibaba_cloud_facebody/): Use Alibaba Cloud FaceBody for face verification.

- [Log providers](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/log/overview/): Collect OS logs, SELinux audit events, OpenTelemetry data, and permission audit events into Casdoor Entry records.
- [Scan provider overview](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/scan/overview/): Scan networks and web targets to discover servers or security issues, e.g. for MCP or vulnerability scanning.
- [MCP Scan](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/scan/mcp/): Scan intranet address ranges to discover MCP servers.
- [Security Scan](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/provider/scan/security/): Fingerprint web targets and report matching known vulnerabilities (CVEs).

## SaaS management

- [概述](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/pricing/overview/): Use Casdoor for subscription and pricing: plans, payments, and subscriptions.
- [Product](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/products/product/): Define products (or services) to sell and attach payment providers.
- [Product store](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/products/product-store/): Publish products to a storefront where users can browse and purchase
- [Shopping cart](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/products/cart/): Collect multiple products before purchasing them together
- [支付](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/products/payment/): View payment records, states, and issue invoices.
- [Order](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/products/order/): Track and manage product purchases with orders
- [计划](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/pricing/plan/): Define a plan’s features and price; plans are tied to roles and products.
- [Pricing](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/pricing/): Group one or more plans so users can sign up at different price points.
- [订阅](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/pricing/subscription/): Manage a user’s selected plan and application access.
- [Transaction](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/pricing/transaction/): Track payments and balance changes for users and organizations.
- [Coupon](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/pricing/coupon/): Create discount coupons and apply them to orders at checkout.

## 同步器

- [概述](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/overview/): 将外部系统（数据库、Azure AD、Keycloak 等）中的用户同步到 Casdoor。
- [数据库同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/Database/): 从外部数据库同步用户数据到Casdoor。
- [Azure AD 同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/AzureAD/): <b通过Microsoft Graph将用户从Azure Active Directory（Microsoft Entra ID）同步到Casdoor。
- [Active Directory 同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/ActiveDirectory/): 通过LDAP/LDAPS将用户从Microsoft Active Directory同步到Casdoor。
- [Google Workspace 同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/GoogleWorkspace/): 通过Admin SDK目录API，将Google Workspace中的用户同步到Casdoor。
- [Keycloak同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/Keycloak/): 将用户从 Keycloak 同步到 Casdoor，并自动映射模式。
- [Okta同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/Okta/): 通过Okta用户API将用户从Okta同步到Casdoor。
- [SCIM 2.0同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/SCIM/): 从任何符合SCIM 2.0标准的身份提供商中将用户拉入Casdoor。
- [AWS IAM同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/AWSIAM/): 将 AWS IAM 中的用户和组同步到 Casdoor。
- [WeCom 同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/WeCom/): 通过WeCom API将用户从企业微信同步到Casdoor。
- [DingTalk同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/DingTalk/): 通过钉钉API将用户从钉钉同步到Casdoor。
- [Lark同步器](https://casdoor.ai/zh/docs/syncer/Lark/): 通过Lark开放平台API，将用户从Lark（飞书）同步到Casdoor。
